name: Eden

launch.notes: CUSTOM_CONFIG_ACTION = 'dev.eden.eden_emulator.LAUNCH_WITH_CUSTOM_CONFIG' (constant, not derived from the applicationId, so it is the same string for nightly/legacy packages), EXTRA_TITLE_ID = 'title_id' (16 hex digits), EXTRA_CUSTOM_SETTINGS = 'custom_settings' (the COMPLETE per-game INI text). Eden looks the game up by title ID in ITS OWN game list (the Switch folder must be added in Eden), shows a launch confirmation dialog, asks before overwriting an existing per-game config, writes the text to config/custom/<TITLEID>.ini, and offers to download a missing driver named in [GpuDriver] driver_path. Handled in EmulationFragment.handleEmuReadyIntent (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eden-emulator/mirror/master/src/android/app/src/main/java/org/yuzu/yuzu_emu/fragments/EmulationFragment.kt). The intent filter is declared in https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eden-emulator/mirror/master/src/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml.

alternateLaunch.notes: Plain launch without applying settings (manifest declares VIEW + mimeType application/octet-stream + scheme content). ES-DE instead uses %ACTION%=android.nfc.action.TECH_DISCOVERED %DATA%=%ROMPROVIDER% (https://gitlab.com/es-de/emulationstation-de/-/raw/master/resources/systems/android/es_systems.xml); use that as a second fallback if VIEW fails.

configTarget.notes: No file access needed: the INI travels inside the launch intent. Per-game file format (WriteSettingGeneric/ReadSettingGeneric in config.cpp): for each overridden switchable setting write three lines in its category section: '<key>\use_global=false', '<key>\default=<true if value equals the emulator default else false>', '<key>=<value>'. If '\default' is true Eden uses the built-in default instead of the value, so never write default=true unless value == default. Enums are written as their integer index (settings_setting.h ToString), bools as true/false. Section names come from TranslateCategory (settings.cpp): Renderer/RendererAdvanced/RendererHacks -> [Renderer], Cpu/CpuDebug/CpuUnsafe -> [Cpu], Core -> [Core], System -> [System]. File name uses the program ID as %016X (native_config.cpp). The mirror repo on GitHub mirrors git.eden-emu.dev; Eden changes quickly, so the app must show the Eden versionName it was tested with and warn on enum-count mismatches.

settings.label: Resolution scale
settings.description: Multiplier on the Switch's native resolution (720p handheld / 1080p docked). Heaviest GPU knob.

settings.label: Asynchronous shaders
settings.description: Compiles shaders in the background: far less stutter, some effects appear late or flicker briefly.

settings.label: Disk shader cache
settings.description: Saves compiled shaders so later sessions stutter less. Keep on.

settings.label: GPU accuracy
settings.description: High fixes some rendering bugs at a large performance cost.

settings.label: Window scaling filter
settings.description: Filter used to scale the rendered image to the screen. FSR sharpens a lower internal resolution.

settings.label: Graphics API
settings.description: Keep Vulkan on Android unless a game specifically needs OpenGL.

settings.label: Multicore CPU emulation
settings.description: Emulates the Switch's CPU cores on separate threads. Keep on unless a game needs it off.

settings.label: Console mode
settings.description: Games render at 720p handheld or 1080p docked. Docked is sharper on the Thor's 1080p screen but heavier.

settings.label: GPU clock (emulated)
settings.description: Reported GPU timing; affects games with dynamic resolution or frame pacing logic.

presets.name: Thor Balanced
presets.description: Handheld mode, 1x, asynchronous shaders, FSR scaling to the 1080p screen.

values.reason: Eden's Android default; community guidance says choose Docked or Handheld per game (joeysretrohandhelds.com Eden guide, search snippet only).

values.description: Background shader compilation to cut stutter.
values.reason: Community guides describe toggling asynchronous shaders per game on Snapdragon devices (search snippet only); enabled in the baseline because stutter dominates first-play experience.

values.description: AMD FSR upscaling of the 720p image to the 1080p panel.
values.reason: Handheld 720p output is upscaled to a 1080p panel; FSR (ScalingFilter::Fsr = 6) sharpens that cheaply.

presets.name: Thor Performance
presets.description: 0.75x scale in handheld mode with async shaders and FSR, for heavy 3D games.

values.reason: One step below native to gain GPU headroom (ResolutionSetup::Res3_4X = index 2).
Recovers sharpness lost to the lower internal resolution.

presets.name: Thor Quality
presets.description: Docked mode (1080p) at 1x with FXAA, for lighter games.

values.description: Docked mode: 1080p render, native for the top screen.
values.reason: Matches the Thor's 1920x1080 top panel; heavier than handheld.

values.description: Disable multicore when using the JIT CPU backend.

manualNotes: Eden needs user-dumped firmware and keys (not handled by this app).
The Switch games folder must be added inside Eden, otherwise LAUNCH_WITH_CUSTOM_CONFIG reports 'game not found for title ID'.

GPU driver: leave [GpuDriver] driver_path empty by default. Eden can recommend a driver itself; a Thor-specific community snippet reports no clear gain from custom drivers on the Thor (joeysretrohandhelds.com, search snippet only).
